description: Godot node: rename a node. Note: scripts or NodePaths that refer to the old name are not updated.

path.description: Node path relative to the scene root ("." is the root), e.g. "Player/Sprite2D".

scene.description: Scene file, e.g. "res://main.tscn". Defaults to the scene open in the editor; required when the editor is closed.

name: godot_node_rename
title: Rename node
